header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners nor any intimation is received. This
body: petition was filed in the year 2020 with prayer that directions be issued to the respondents to remove the BTS Zong Company tower. The said company is a private entity, against which petition under Article 199 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is not maintainable. Accordingly, instant petition stands dismissed along with listed applications.
